name: carousel
title: Carousel
description: A row of slides you scroll or step through with buttons.
a11y: A named region with aria-roledescription="carousel"; each slide is a group named "N of M".
Previous and Next are real buttons; the track is also scrollable by keyboard and touch.
No auto-play, so nothing moves without the user.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the carousel, for example "Featured projects".
